subject: Priority decision: runtime infra headcount tranche (Q4 request)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-30T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Priority decision: runtime infra headcount tranche (Q4 request)

Kimberly / Vanessa —

Following up on the runtime team’s Q4 headcount request. We are asking for a tranche of 3 hires (2 senior runtime engineers, 1 infra reliability engineer) to support the GPU pool expansion and low-latency inference work tied to the Acme AI POC (Elaine copied on this thread). High-level ask and rationale are in the attached HC_Request_Q4.xlsx. Key points:

- Business need: Acme POC + expected 2x traffic increase in Nov after benchmark release.
- Impact if not approved: longer lead time for GPU optimization, potential SLA misses for dedicated customers.
- Proposed bands: two at Senior (L5) and one at Staff-adjacent (L6 proxy) compensation; suggested ranges in Comp_Band_Proposal.pdf.
- Cost model: incremental monthly run shown in Cost_Model_Run.txt — shows ~9% uplift to Q4 infra spend if hires start in Oct.

Requesting a decision today on whether to: (A) approve full tranche starting Oct 15, (B) approve two hires now and queue the third for Jan, or (C) decline (we’ll triage scope).

Can you flag blockers (band exceptions, budget) and we’ll surface to finance/exec if needed? I’ll compile feedback for the hiring committee.

Thanks —
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Runtime Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HC_Request_Q4.xlsx, Comp_Band_Proposal.pdf, Cost_Model_Run.txt

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Priority decision: runtime infra headcount tranche (Q4 request)

Marcus —

Thanks for the packet and the clarity on timing. From a comp-band and approval perspective I have two immediate asks before I can greenlight: 

1) Band justification for the L6 proxy role. The Comp_Band_Proposal.pdf lists an outlier midpoint that will require a compensation exception if we follow the current ranges. Please add 2–3 benchmark comps (internal comparable roles or market data) showing why we should stretch the band.

2) Detailed ramp plan with milestone-driven hiring checkpoints (30/60/90) so we can align payroll and expected deliverables for the tranche.

If both items are ok, I can sign off on the two Senior hires today and route the L6 exception to the comp committee. If the L6 needs to stay in-tranche and the committee is unlikely to approve, we should consider the staggered approach (approve two now, one later).

I’m adding Vanessa for budget confirmation — Vanessa, do we have headroom in Q4 OPEX for this tranche with the 9% uplift Marcus called out?

-Kim
Kimberly Park
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: Comp_Band_Proposal.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-30T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Priority decision: runtime infra headcount tranche (Q4 request)

Marcus / Kim —

Quick note from recruiting: we have two strong pipeline candidates for the Senior runtime roles (one is an internal ref with immediate availability). The L6 search will take longer (6–8 weeks) given the senior bar and compensation sensitivity. Proposed practical approach: 

- Accelerate the two Senior offers this week (fast-track interviews + verbal offers) so they accept in Oct.
- Open the L6 as a rolling SR search with a February start target if we need to wait on comp committee approval.
- If leadership approves the L6 band exception today, we can compress the timeline to 4 weeks.

Recruiting can prepare offer structures consistent with the Comp_Band_Proposal.pdf but will need final sign-off on the L6 cash target and equity band before sending formal offer letters.

Sooj
Soojín Lee
Head of Engineering Recruiting
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-30T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Priority decision: runtime infra headcount tranche (Q4 request)

Team —

From a product/ops priority lens I recommend approving option (B): fund the two Senior hires now and defer the L6 until we get comp committee clarity. Rationale:

- Two seniors allow us to hit the GPU kernel improvements and KV cache work needed for Acme POC readiness.
- The L6 provides breadth but is not on the critical path for the Nov benchmark release.
- Staggering reduces immediate budget pressure while preserving runway to secure the L6 in Q1.

Action items I propose:
1) Vanessa to confirm the revised Q4 OPEX line for two hires (approx. 6% uplift).
2) Kim to prepare the comp-exception packet for the L6 (if we decide to pursue) for the comp committee meeting next week.
3) Soojin to move forward on verbal offers for the two Senior roles and return with acceptance timeline.

If Vanessa confirms budget, I’ll escalate a one-off approval to finance to commit the two hires for Oct start.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Elaine Matthews <elaine@acme.ai>
Date: 2025-09-30T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Priority decision: runtime infra headcount tranche (Q4 request)

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Summary and next steps I’ll own: 

- Decision: proceed with option (B) — approve two Senior hires now, defer L6 until comp committee decision.
- Vanessa: please confirm the OPEX update (target: approve 2 hires, ~6% Q4 uplift).
- Kim: we’ll prepare the comp packet for the L6 exception; please schedule comp committee review for next Wednesday.
- Soojin: proceed with fast-track interviews and prepare verbal offers for the two Senior candidates; target acceptance by 10/10.
- Jonas: I’ll loop finance and get the final approval note reflected in HC-4321.

Elaine — thanks for your patience on timing; we expect to have the two Senior engineers in place before the POC milestone in November. I’ll keep you posted on concrete start dates.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Runtime Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
